scope: OpenCourant phone9 full output corners C6
purpose: A bounded first comparison using measured resources; not an optimized recipe, convergence claim or universal algorithm ranking.

data.support: Use each domain's frozen complete output support, stored times and common train-only normalization. No node subsampling for this comparison.
data.splits: Keep phone5/2/2 and bumper112/12/7 simulation splits.
data.test_access: Source/READY verification may hash held-out files. Held-out values must not determine batch size, training duration, weights or checkpoint selection. These simulation splits have already been evaluated by separately reported ROM methods; they are not a globally unseen research holdout.

batch_selection.evidence: Actual fixed-weight output/gradient/independence and Adam-update probes on training cases only; B2/B5 use a strict train-file loader.
batch_selection.rule: Use a passing candidate with measured throughput improvement in both timing repeats and sufficient measured GPU memory. Preserve any failed or unattempted larger-batch outcome. Do not claim identical optimizer trajectories when batch size changes.

training.quality_gate_failure: Report failure without silently extending the declared budget.
training.timing: Accumulate synchronized forward/loss/backward/Adam-update elapsed time. Report data reading, normalization, host/device transfer, setup, validation, checkpoint I/O and total wall separately. Concurrent local workloads must be recorded.
training.validation_interval: At the next complete epoch after each additional 15 seconds of optimizer compute, plus initial and final complete-epoch states.
training.checkpoint: Choose minimum full internal-validation loss among complete-epoch states. Record partial final-epoch work but do not select that unevaluated state. Preserve best and final-state provenance.
training.near_cap_improvement: Explicitly report that convergence is unverified when validation is still improving near the cap.

evaluation.selection_roundtrip: Verify serialization on validation input after freezing the best checkpoint.
evaluation.test: One held-out performance prediction pass per frozen configuration in a fresh process. Further metric recomputation uses saved predictions rather than reselecting a model.
evaluation.metrics: Physical-unit RMSE, relative L2, P95/max, raw negative output counts, EPSP support/history, strain principal ordering where applicable and centroid-removed displacement error.
evaluation.baseline_scope: Use identical field/support/split definitions for direct ROM comparisons. Earlier displacement-only or differently normalized experiments remain separate.

resource: Local RTX3060 Laptop6GiB. One GPU worker at a time. The user separately approved extending the central phone FEM to0.5ms; record any concurrent solver workload and resource interference. No paid resources.
